title: How I separated AI signal choices from crossing rules in a Godot traffic sim
author: ViceGodIm
selftext:
I built a four-junction Godot sim and wired a GPT model into the same signal interface as a queue-based controller. It gets structured state and picks a phase every five simulated seconds. Both controllers replay the same arrivals and routes. Godot decides when a car can actually cross, so you can debug a bad signal choice separately from the movement rules. In this shot, both directions have green but an opposing turn gets the crossing slot first. I kept the slot order visible in the replay because the light alone doesn’t explain the delay.



My Godot replay: [https://youtu.be/YY41\_8\_H-O8](https://youtu.be/YY41_8_H-O8)
